# LERP (Luau Education for Rive Professionals)
> Canonical URL: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/
> Purpose: Practical training for Rive Luau scripting, from fundamentals to advanced protocols.
> Language: English

## Audience
- Motion designers and technical artists using Rive
- Developers implementing interactive Rive experiences with Luau
- Teams standardizing scripting patterns and code quality
